catalogue.name: branching_location
catalogue.eligibility: Current location on an edge with >=2 legal passenger successors

catalogue.name: single_exit_location
catalogue.eligibility: Current location on an edge with exactly one legal successor

catalogue.name: rare_poi_context
catalogue.eligibility: Location with a rare POI context; requires a pinned POI rarity model

catalogue.name: short_scheduled_stop
catalogue.eligibility: Actual scheduled stop lasting >=20 s; sample every 5 s

catalogue.name: long_scheduled_stop
catalogue.eligibility: Actual scheduled stop lasting >=120 s; sample every 20 s

catalogue.name: return_to_stop
catalogue.eligibility: Two realized scheduled stops on the same lane separated by movement

catalogue.name: moving_sequence
catalogue.eligibility: >=60 s of moving FCD, >=3 distinct external edges; 20 s queries

catalogue.name: forced_corridor
catalogue.eligibility: Moving sequence with >=50% sampled edges having one legal successor

catalogue.name: sparse_queries
catalogue.eligibility: Same realized moving sequence sampled every 60 s

catalogue.name: same_person_same_device
catalogue.eligibility: Separate, non-overlapping sessions by the same person and device

catalogue.name: same_person_new_device
catalogue.eligibility: Same person, different device; person linkage and device linkage differ

catalogue.name: different_person_shared_device
catalogue.eligibility: Different people reuse a device in non-overlapping sessions

catalogue.name: next_turn_at_fork
catalogue.eligibility: Prefix ends before a transition with >=2 legal successors; label next external edge

catalogue.name: forced_next_turn
catalogue.eligibility: Exactly one legal successor; structural lower-uncertainty control

catalogue.name: shared_prefix_fork
catalogue.eligibility: Two planned routes share a prefix then diverge; realized choices checked

catalogue.name: shared_prefix_destinations
catalogue.eligibility: Different completed destinations with the same planned prefix

catalogue.name: nearby_destinations
catalogue.eligibility: Completed alternative destinations separated by <=500 m

catalogue.name: routine_vs_rare_destination
catalogue.eligibility: Requires a multi-day activity schedule with specified destination frequencies

catalogue.name: plaintext_intent_control
catalogue.eligibility: One explicit sensitive query; location-only protection cannot conceal plaintext

catalogue.name: constant_query_cover_control
catalogue.eligibility: Six-category reference cover, with true category evaluator-only

catalogue.name: sequence_intent
catalogue.eligibility: Three synthetic intents share a first query but have different continuations

catalogue.name: partial_companionship
catalogue.eligibility: Declared companion pair shares a route prefix then separates; >=10 s within 100 m

catalogue.name: full_route_companionship
catalogue.eligibility: Declared companion pair uses the same route; >=80% overlapping timestamps within 100 m

catalogue.name: incidental_proximity
catalogue.eligibility: No declared companionship but >=10 s within 100 m: a hard negative

catalogue.name: single_exit_origin
catalogue.eligibility: First recorded edge has one legal exit; first 60 s withheld

catalogue.name: merging_origins
catalogue.eligibility: Different origins merge onto a common suffix; disclose only from merge

catalogue.name: repeated_origin
catalogue.eligibility: Two completed trips from the same simulated origin; mask both first 60 s

catalogue.name: single_access_endpoint
catalogue.eligibility: Final recorded edge has one legal incoming edge; last 60 s withheld

catalogue.name: diverging_endpoints
catalogue.eligibility: Common route prefix leads to different endpoints; disclose before divergence

catalogue.name: repeated_endpoint
catalogue.eligibility: Two completed trips to the same simulated endpoint; mask both last 60 s
